judgment_calls.decision: Drug rash = Eruption caused by drug (disorder), triggered either by a recorded drug eruption or by the possible diagnosis from 'suspect a drug rash'.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Generalized rash alone as trigger (too broad); Adverse reaction caused by drug.

judgment_calls.decision: Added systolic < 90 or diastolic < 60 to the urgent markers because footnote 2 lists it and red box 2 sends markers of severity to urgent attention.

Eruption caused by drug with finding_site Mouth region / Eye region / Genital structure.
